main.name: Dr. Simon Hung
main.title: Chairman, ORTV & IAA
main.bio: Elder Simon Hung dedicated his early years to the Bread of Life Multimedia, pioneering gospel films, music, and media ministry — earning recognition as a trailblazer in Chinese evangelical arts and media missions. After stepping down as president in 2019, he has continued to champion gospel media development and currently serves as Chairman of the Christian Tribune.

main.name: Dr. Timothy Cheng
main.title: International Executive Director, IAA
main.bio: Currently serving as President of the Christian Tribune and Executive Director of Impact Asia Center, Dr. Cheng leads media and church renewal through innovative and transformative thinking. He guided the Tribune through its digital transformation, expanding news, commentary, and lifestyle content into a vital public platform for the Chinese church. At Impact Asia Center, he actively builds cross-national church exchange and cooperation networks, spreading faith ideals broadly across Asia with far-reaching influence.

coChairs.name: Rev. Paulus Wong
coChairs.title: IAA Malaysian Convener
coChairs.bio: Senior Pastor of the Chinese congregation at Grace Community Church Seremban, IAA Malaysia Convener, Chinese Chairman of the National Evangelical Christian Fellowship (NECF), and Chairman of the Chinese Global Leadership Summit (GLS) Malaysia.

coChairs.name: Rev. Yoshiko Ito
coChairs.title: Shiroi-ie Fellowship Church
coChairs.bio: Rev. Yoshiko Ito serves as the Senior Pastor of the Shiroi-ie Fellowship Church in Okinawa and Principal of the affiliated Shiroi-ie Christian School. She also hosts the Okinawa gospel radio program "Yoshiko Ito's Beautiful Gift," chairs the Okinawa Executive Committee for the TV program "Lifeline," and leads the NPO "Father's House," which provides day care and after-school services. Her ministry spans church, education, media, and social welfare, with tireless dedication to the expansion of God's Kingdom at home and abroad.
